faq.question: What Amazon content do you write?
faq.answer: We write titles, bullets, descriptions, and A+ Content copy. Scope can also include brand story modules and launch messaging for priority ASINs.

faq.question: Does A+ Content improve Amazon search ranking?
faq.answer: A+ Content does not directly improve organic search rank. Amazon ranking is driven mainly by sales velocity, conversion, relevance, and related performance signals. A+ helps educate shoppers and support conversion after they reach the page.

faq.question: Do you research keywords before writing?
faq.answer: Yes. Copy is informed by keyword priorities and listing SEO strategy so discoverability and readability stay balanced.

faq.question: Can you match our existing brand voice?
faq.answer: Yes. We work from brand guidelines and approved examples, then lock voice standards for ongoing Amazon copy.

faq.question: How do you handle claim accuracy?
faq.answer: We draft from product facts you provide and flag unsupported claims for review before publishing.

faq.question: How is content writing different from listing optimization?
faq.answer: Listing optimization covers keyword strategy and structural SEO priorities. Content writing produces the customer-facing copy that executes those priorities.

faq.question: Which Amazon marketplaces do you support?
faq.answer: We support content work across official Amazon Seller Central marketplaces: United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Poland, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, South Africa, India, Japan, Australia, and Singapore. Scope for a specific account is confirmed during your audit consultation.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com. Typical next steps are a content gap review, priority ASIN plan, then drafting and publish support.
